sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Image-Text-to-Text model with 5B parameters, built with Transformers. Download, explore files and run it on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 4B — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 4B is a 4-billion-parameter open-source model supporting text and image inputs, released under Apache 2.0 license. The model supports a 262K token context window and is available through open weights for local deployment and commercial inference providers.
